title: 6TiSCHSet-2026: A Multi-Layer 6TiSCH Attack Dataset and Leakage-Aware IDS Benchmark
description:
6TiSCHSet-2026 is an open, labelled attack dataset for IETF 6TiSCH networks, together with the evaluation protocol and the analysis code used in the companion paper.

Contents. 206 Contiki-NG / Cooja runs and 2,083,168 labelled telemetry records: 84 single-attacker placement runs and 2 attacker-free baseline runs (data/single/), 36 concurrent two-attacker runs (data/multiattack/), and an 84-run replication of the placement design over three radio seeds (data/multiseed/). Every run ships three files with a shared stem: raw telemetry .log, radio capture .pcap, and a clean header-prefixed .csv. manifest.csv records the scale, placement, attacker density, attacker-selection seed, radio seed, record and attacker-row counts, and attacker mote IDs of every run.

Attacks. Seven families across five planes of the 6TiSCH stack: Blackhole (data), Decreased Rank (routing), DIS Flooding (control), Application Flooding (application), and three MAC-plane families, TSCH Shared Cell Contention, 6P Cell Allocation Exhaustion and TSCH Desynchronization.

Schema. Each record is 20 integers: 3 identifiers, 15 behavioural features drawn from the RPL, TSCH, 6P, application, energy and PHY planes, and 2 ground-truth labels. See schema.md.

Evaluation protocol. The release fixes a group-aware protocol with group key (run_id, node_id) as part of the specification rather than leaving it to each user. code/analysis/eval_core_tables.py regenerates the paper's core tables cell by cell from the released logs; REPRODUCING.md lists the command for every table and figure.

Scope. All runs use the customised 4emac TSCH implementation with a 15 ms timeslot, so the release should be read as a 4emac/6TiSCH dataset; the MAC-plane conclusions are stated with that boundary in the paper.
notes: Supported by Karadeniz Technical University Scientific Research Projects Unit (KTUBAP) under Project 18267. The customised Contiki-NG used in the implementation was provided by Mavi Alp Information Technologies.
